description: This file defines the KeyHandler class responsible for generating, reading, and managing cryptographic keys for the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to create a new key, read an existing key from the filesystem, check for key existence, and retrieve the key's file path.

classes.name: KeyHandler
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to create and retrieve cryptographic keys used for encryption within the system.

methods.name: createKey
methods.description: Generates a new cryptographic key, saves it to disk, and throws an exception if a key already exists or if there is an error during creation.

methods.name: readKey
methods.description: Reads and returns the cryptographic key from the filesystem, throwing exceptions if the key does not exist or is not readable.

methods.name: keyExists
methods.description: Checks if the key file exists at the specified path.

methods.name: getRealPathToKey
methods.description: Returns the absolute path to the key file if it exists, or null otherwise.

methods.name: getPathToKey
methods.description: Returns the configured filesystem path to the key file.
